historical_record.description: The building was a former church rectory, used as group housing for a religious order, proposed as a residential care facility for up to 24 people.
The City Planning Commission granted conditional-use authorization, 5-2, to convert the former church rectory into a residential care facility for up to 24 people in 11 bedrooms (Motion 13748).
By 17 November 1994 the Board of Supervisors had upheld, 8-1, the City Planning Commission's approval of the Walden House residential care facility here.
Walden House, Inc. used the property under a conditional use granted on 25 August 1994 (Motion 13748), on whose conditions it reported to the Commission.
